description:
Low-priority provider re-review log for deferred hosted-ClickHouse vendors, bootstrapped with the 2026-09-29 landscape review. Each entry records last verdict, revisit trigger, and evidence required for promotion to a spike. This item is documentation-only; it creates no adapters and changes no code.

Bootstrapped entries:
- ChistaDATA Cloud: services-led managed ClickHouse. Verdict: park. Revisit trigger: enterprise user brings an account; then open a new spike item.
- Elestio Managed ClickHouse: thin ops wrapper on dedicated VMs. Verdict: park. Revisit trigger: Tier 2 stalls and a cheap trial path is needed; then open a new spike item.
- Yandex Cloud Managed ClickHouse: genuine managed service. Verdict: deprioritize (sanctions exposure, RU-region residency, declining Western trial access). Revisit trigger: explicit user demand with account in hand.
- Alibaba ApsaraDB for ClickHouse: genuine service, actively versioned. Verdict: deprioritize (Enterprise Edition diverges from open source, painful non-CN trial access). Revisit trigger: explicit user demand with account in hand.

Explicit exclusions (do not promote without new evidence they host endpoints): cloud marketplaces (billing channels, not endpoints), ManageStacks/MSP wrappers (stock ClickHouse, use clickhouse-server), Gigapipe/HyperDX/ClickStack (observability over your own ClickHouse, not hosts), Qryn (dormant), Clever Cloud (no ClickHouse add-on), OVH Logs Data Platform (OpenSearch, not ClickHouse).

DECISION GATE: revisit any Tier 3 vendor only on its listed trigger. Revisit is a new spike item, not silent scope expansion and not a reopen of this log.
